scope: isolated independent DCT v2.1; same encoders, slots, transport and existing heads; six training terms

uniform_budget_risk_response.claim: same actual marginals but distinct matching responses; analytic witness checked against implementation

mechanism_witnesses.quality_scale: residual scales linearly with actual mass; no additional local ratio or total mass multiplier
mechanism_witnesses.zero_deployment_gain: fixed positive auxiliary probe retains cost-only gradient on nondegenerate slots; actual deployed gain remains free
mechanism_witnesses.equal_plan_comparison: softplus derivative in gap is 1/2 at equality; tested nonzero projected cost gradient
mechanism_witnesses.exact_slot_collision: true L2-margin selected generalized gradient is nonzero and bounded; direct slot update lowers loss
mechanism_witnesses.upstream_collision: identical prototypes with nondegenerate tokens receive separating gradient; identical tokens are retained as a counterexample to universal escape
mechanism_witnesses.degenerate_support: zero/tiny mass or single supported row/column imposes zero relation penalty
mechanism_witnesses.freeze_and_recovery: only cost network receives relation gradient, actual budgets and heads are fixed; mixed train/eval flags restored after deliberate solver failure

fix_applied_during_debug: new model relative imports failed dynamic factory; corrected only new model to absolute imports and verified actual construction
limitations: Repairs specific mechanical degeneracies, not a proof of patient improvement or globally novel mathematics.
Auxiliary probe is not deployed prediction; it does not guarantee deployed transport gain remains nonzero.
Centered risk coactivation cannot distinguish all couplings and vanishes with constant response on one modality.
Chosen exact-collision generalized gradient can still be blocked by an upstream zero or identical Jacobian.
Budgets are frozen within each auxiliary comparison, not causally fixed across the whole optimization trajectory.
user_run_boundary: Run only after copying the local new version to the server and verifying existing derived outer-test splits and feature paths; command not executed by this audit.
